description: Platform dependency policy (SEC-74). Renovate reads config from the repo root only; the root renovate.json should extend this file (see docs/runbooks/environments.md).

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all non-major updates
AWS CDK library and CLI move together
Expo-managed: versions come from `expo install --fix` during an SDK upgrade, never from Renovate
Surface new Expo SDKs only; the upgrade itself is `pnpm exec expo install expo@^<sdk> --fix` (docs/mobile.md)
prBodyNotes: Do not merge as-is: run `cd platform/mobile && pnpm exec expo install expo@<version> --fix && pnpm expo:doctor` on this branch.
